method: Frame uses count only regions[].affordances[].actionRef; distinct frames establish cross-frame reuse. Flow uses count only primary/alternate steps[].actionRef; distinct flows establish cross-flow reuse. Exclude task indexes, focus/trigger references, feedback ownership, decisions and UI projections. Baseline comparison uses exact action JSON equality ignoring object-key order, preserving array order.
limitations: Frame and flow uses overlap the same behavior and must not be added as unique user interactions.
An unchanged stored action does not by itself prove zero model rereading or reserialization.
A reference occurrence is not an additional action definition or a repeated-text count.
